decision_cruda.rationale: Radio and CMMS agree on both failures (LH-01 back 12:30-14:30, LH-02 13:30-15:30). The two stopes are the richest (15.4 and 13.0 g/t) and have enough ore left. Este has truck headroom (72 t/h against 36 t/h inflow) and a stockpile at 171 of 450 t. Central stockpile is at 264 of 450 t, so it has room for the extra ore. LH-08 goes to C512-04 (0.26 h away): about 170 t x 0.418 oz/t = 71 oz, minus 1.9 oz/h x 7 h = 14 oz, net ~57. LH-09 goes to E595-06 (0.38 h away): about 198 t x 0.495 oz/t = 98 oz, minus 4 oz/h x 7 h = 28 oz, net ~70. LH-10 is not available until 11:00, so I did not plan it. Both loans are revisable once the repairs finish.
